title: Yang et al. 2025 — A multi-day and high-quality EEG dataset for motor imagery brain-computer interface
description: A multi-day electroencephalography (EEG) dataset for motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) research, collected at Shanghai University (WBCIC-SHU). It includes 51 healthy, BCI-naive participants who each completed three sessions on different days. Participants performed two-class (left/right hand) motor imagery, and a subset of 11 also performed three-class imagery (adding foot-hooking). The data were recorded with 59 EEG channels at 1000 Hz, and benchmark classifiers (CSP+SVM, FBCSP+SVM, EEGNet, deepConvNet, FBCNet) are reported.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W system (59 EEG channels plus ECG and EOG, Ag/AgCl sensors, 1000 Hz sampling rate). Each trial was 7.5 s, with video cues followed by 4 s of motor imagery. Participants imagined left-hand or right-hand movements (and foot-hooking in the three-class subset) over 3 sessions on different days, 200 trials per session for the 2-class task and 300 for the 3-class task. Evaluation used 10-fold within-session cross-validation.
